2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)]
MINISTRY OF MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES
NOTIFICATION
New Delhi, the 12th October, 2026
S.O. 5575(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by sub -section (2) of section 1 of the Micro,
Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Act, 2026 (16 of 2026), the Central Government
hereby appoints, –
(a) the 15th October, 2026 as the date on which the provisions of sections 2 to 7 (both inclusive), section
11 and sections 13 to 17 (both inclusive) of the said Act shall come into force;
(b) the 15th December, 2026 as the date on which the provisions of section 12 of the said Act shall come
into force.
[F. No. 2/1(1)/2022-P&G/Policy/E]
Dr. RAJNEESH, Addl. Secy.
